name: angular-to-react
description: Convert Angular / AngularJS code to React. Paste an Angular component in any Claude app and get the React version, or plan and run a full incremental migration of your repo in Claude Code.

interface.longDescription: Convert Angular / AngularJS code to React. Paste an Angular component in any Claude app and get the React version, or plan and run a full incremental migration of your repo in Claude Code. Keeps resumable migration state in .migration/, inventories the app before changing code, and checks each migrated piece for parity with the original.
